title: Add read-only experiment simplification and alias clustering review
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic read-only simplification review over the existing Experiment Lifecycle registry that flags semantic/path alias families, high-observation zero-outcome incubation and repeated matured-inconclusive families for governance review without automatically merging, retiring, promoting or changing weights.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/experiments/directly related read-only experiment simplification review helper
research/experiment_lifecycle/directly related generated simplification review artifact

evidence.summary: Registry contains 153 candidates, including large INCUBATING and MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE populations plus repeated mark-price path aliases.
Lifecycle normalizes candidate identity but historical namespace variants can remain separate candidate identities; automatic_age_expiry is false.
Current governance prefers relationship audit, simplification and latent-factor compression over accumulating redundant confirmation.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect LATEST_EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.json and identify multiple candidate IDs representing equivalent target/direction families through namespace/path aliases and a large set of matured-inconclusive/incubating candidates. Confirm no deterministic review artifact currently groups these for KEEP/MERGE_REVIEW/RETIRE_REVIEW without mutation.

positive: Equivalent known path-alias candidates with the same kind/direction/horizon are grouped with every original candidate ID preserved.
The report separately flags high-observation zero-outcome incubation and repeated matured-inconclusive families.
negative: Distinct hypotheses are not collapsed solely because they share a metric path.
No candidate is deleted, rewritten, auto-retired, auto-merged, promoted or assigned a model weight by the review.
